method: Trial summary read directly (pace-cme.org, with full NEJM citation and results).

claims.claim: In a 12-month RCT of 139 adults, eating the same calories within 8 hours gave similar weight loss to daily calorie restriction; the difference was not statistically significant.
claims.source_title: Calorie Restriction with or without Time-Restricted Eating in Weight Loss
claims.authors: Liu D, Huang Y, Huang C, et al.
claims.study_type: Randomized controlled trial, 12 months, n=139 (adults with obesity, China)
claims.finding: TRE (8:00-16:00) -8.0 kg vs daily calorie restriction -6.3 kg; net -1.8 kg (95% CI -4.0 to 0.4). Authors: caloric restriction explained most of the beneficial effects.

limitations: Single-centre trial in China with obesity; the script says 'similar' and 'not statistically certain'.
